We had already fought off the Machine God Soldiers[XENO:n ]
a year ago, at the Battle of Sword Valley.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
It left us with a false sense of security.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

The Colony 6 Defence Force didn't[XENO:n ]
even notice the approaching Machine God Soldiers.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

By the time the air-raid siren sounded,[XENO:n ]
a swarm of Mechon had blackened the sky.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

They ate people and burned our buildings. Me and Juujuu[XENO:n ]
dedicated ourselves to evacuating the children and elderly.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I don't know what happened next.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
It's just like what happened to Colony 9.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]They attacked your colony as well?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Yes. It's good that you managed to evacuate so many.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Odama-san... it's thanks[XENO:n ]
to the defence captain and Gado.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
This Gado...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]He would have been my husband[XENO:n ]
by now if not for all this.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Cheer up, you two![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Er...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]We can't lose hope just yet![XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I'm certain Gado and the other soldiers[XENO:n ]
are alive. They're still fighting. I can feel it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Erm...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Hmm?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You're on your way to Colony 6, right?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]You bet! We're up for some revenge.[XENO:n ]
I bet we can even get your colony back![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]There you go showing off again...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]No, if it's Rein-san and Shulk-san, then...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Could...um... Could you take[XENO:n ]
me with you to the colony?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Juujuu![XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]The people here need us![XENO:n ]
How many times do I have to tell you?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]But you heard. The Mechon attacked Colony 9![XENO:wait wait=key ]

That means a load of them have[XENO:n ]
left Colony 6 already! It has to![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:line len=2 ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:line len=2 ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:line len=2 ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Even if that's true... No, especially if it's true![XENO:n ]
We cannot expose the camp to any more danger.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]So you don't care what happens[XENO:n ]
to the people in the colony?![XENO:wait wait=key ]

How can you be so heartless?[XENO:n ]
Are you that scared of the Mechon?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
